title: Global Dynamics and Synchronization of Hodgkin-Huxley-Wilson Neural Networks
summary: Hodgkin-Huxley equations as a monumental breakthrough in neuroscience theory had been distilled into many simplified models to study, but this mathematical model itself was not fully investigated in terms of global and asymptotic dynamics due to its strong nonlinearity and higher dimensionality. In this paper a new model called Hodgkin-Huxley-Wilson neural networks is proposed and investigated. This model captures the essential features of the nonlinearity and the conductances of two dominant ionic current channels coupled with the neuron membrane voltage in gated firing and bursting…
